title: Signal Specification
text: Specify desired dimensions, sample time, data type, numeric type, and other attributes of signal, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Data type mode; {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Data type} sets the output data type Inherit, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Require nonvirtual bus} sets the accept only nonvirtual bus signals, {Unit (e.g., m, m/s^2, N*m)} sets the physical unit of the input signal to the block, {Dimensions (-1 for inherited)} sets the dimensions of input and output signals, {Variable-size signal} allows signal to be variable-size, fixed-size, or both, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the time interval between samples, {Signal type} sets the complexity of signal, {Signedness} sets the signed or unsigned Signed, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data and {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Require nonvirtual bus
params.values: Accept only nonvirtual bus signals off (default) | on

params.name: Unit (e.g., m, m/s^2, N*m)
params.values: Physical unit of the input signal to the block inherit (default) | <Enter unit>

params.name: Dimensions (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Dimensions of input and output signals -1 (default) | n | [m n]

params.name: Variable-size signal
params.values: Allow signal to be variable-size, fixed-size, or both Inherit (default) | No | Yes

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Time interval between samples -1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Signal type
params.values: Complexity of signal auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Mode
params.values: Data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Enumerated | Bus object | Value type | Expression

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point | Slope and bias

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Specify fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Slope
params.values: Specify slope for the fixed-point data type 2^0 (default) | positive, real-valued scalar

params.name: Bias
params.values: Specify bias for the fixed-point data type 0 (default) | real-valued scalar
